acceptance: Each supported design/configuration must yield an exact saved board passing native and electrical gates within its declared candidate/time budget. Individual seed failures are retained evidence, not an automatic design failure. This matrix exceeded that gate by passing all twelve repaired cells.
determinism: Seeded candidate generation; wall-clock-bounded searches can vary with execution speed. Reproduction requires exact input artifacts, full seeds/settings, pinned tools/image and equivalent budgets; seeds alone do not guarantee byte-identical boards.
selection: No manual choice or routing; initial pool and recovery select placements mechanically. Seeds 0 and 1 are predeclared regression roots, not cherry-picked winning roots.

native_animation.frames: Prior-paired and integrated header seed 1, two accepted final snapshots; no interpolated geometry.
